title: STE lint: pin three edge cases and close a fence at the end of a blockquote
routed_reason: the stelint package is console-built (plan ste100-docs-rewrite-2026-10, S0); these are the filed items of its round-2 check
source: console, 2026-10-08, the S0 landing (round-2 verify-only check: MERGE, 0 blocking items, 1 MEDIUM and 6 LOW filed; F1, F5 and F6 were fixed at the landing)
summary: The round-2 check of the STE lint filed four items that the landing did not fix. F2: three mutants survive, but the behaviour is correct: the blockquote state is not reset, a quotation ends with ? or !, and the first > line is empty. F3: a fence that a blockquote opens and does not close makes the lint skip the rest of the file, and an HTML comment that closes inside a quoted line never closes. F4: a --- line directly after a list item makes the item a setext heading, so the item gets no length rule. F7: the strict decode accepts stage "0" as off, but the docs name only off, shadow and enforce.
fix: F2: add the three test cases to the existing tables in go/internal/stelint. F3: clear the fence state and the comment state when a blockquote ends, as CommonMark does, and add tests. F4: apply the setext rule only to a prose paragraph. F7: name "0" in docs/architecture/policy-config.md, or refuse it in the decode.
acceptance: The three F2 mutants are killed by named test cases
A blockquote that opens a fence and does not close it does not hide the text after the blockquote
A 30-word list item followed by a --- line gives one STE-SENTENCE finding
The docs and the decode agree on the stage words
